Appearance:
 Shri Sushil Goswami - Advocate for the petitioner.
 Shri A.K.Nirankari - Public Prosecutor for the respondent
 Order

This petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner seeking quashment of FIR registered against him at Crime No.648/2020 at Police Station Aaron, District Guna (MP) for the offences under punishable under Sections 326, 376-D, 506 of IPC and Sections 3(1)(w)(ii), 3(2)(v)
and 3(2)(va) of SCST Act and all consequential proceedings.
2. As per the status report, vide judgment dated 04.01.2024, impugned proceedings have been concluded by the trial Court.
Hence, the purpose of filing the instant petition is over and the petition has rendered infructuous.
3. In view of the aforesaid, nothing survives in this petition to address upon and the same is hereby dismissed having been rendered infructuous.

(ANAND PATHAK)
